MOD = 998244353

def count_distinct_subarrays(n):
    # Calculate the length of the sequence P
    length = n * factorial(n)
    
    # Use a set to store distinct subarrays
    distinct_subarrays = set()
    
    # Generate all permutations of numbers from 1 to n
    from itertools import permutations
    perms = permutations(range(1, n + 1))
    
    # Convert each permutation to a list and concatenate them into P
    P = []
    for perm in perms:
        P.extend(perm)
    
    # Iterate over all possible subarrays
    for i in range(length):
        for j in range(i + 1, length + 1):
            subarray = tuple(P[i:j])
            distinct_subarrays.add(subarray)
    
    # Return the number of distinct subarrays modulo MOD
    return len(distinct_subarrays) % MOD
